ValidationRule.description: The "Future Outreach" queue is no longer available to assign as the Lead Owner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISNEW() ), LEFT(OwnerId,3)='00G', Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Future Outreach' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: User should not be assign "Future Outreach" as owner.
